title: Export files come out unreadable to the reporting team
description_md:
The `dataexport` service account writes fresh files into `/srv/exports` (owned `dataexport:exportreaders`, mode `770`, no setgid bit) with a restrictive `umask` for compliance reasons. The `analyst` user is a member of `exportreaders` and is supposed to be able to read every new export as soon as it lands, but every file `dataexport` creates comes out unreadable to `analyst`. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), work out why brand-new files never end up in the right group, and fix `dataexport` so future exports are readable by `analyst` from the moment they're created.

You're done when a file freshly created by `dataexport` can immediately be read by `analyst`.
